sentences.text: Researchers developed a faster brain scanning technique that employs a specific mathematical approach to separate chemical signals, testing it on 15 people against a standard spectroscopy method.

This new method completed scans approximately 10.58 times faster than the standard approach while incorporating signals from glutamine-glutamate and myo-inositol to enhance the precision of primary brain chemical measurements.
Validation on artificial samples indicated a measurement error of about 12.73% for the main chemicals, and human scans demonstrated moderate agreement between the new and standard techniques.
The authors suggest this method has potential for faster and more accurate brain chemical mapping.
